aggregation_rule: One vote per completed committee decision; shared awards remain distinct configurations; no one-shot answers are pooled.
design: Five shared neutral profile versions per model, five paired shuffles/repetitions per version; 50 writers and six simulated voting members, including co-opted Carlberg by modeling assumption.
